title: PROTO Flowplayer cell
description:
OPTIONS: see PROTO IFrame
URL-OPTIONS:
vid = <VIDEO ID> from annotator URL
gid = 40 for filmings, 41 for YouTube annotations
from = secs | E | E-<N> ... where E is first (E-0) marker, E-<N> is Nth marker
to = see from
loop = 1
angle = rh | lh (filmings only)
perfs = jburrows | mfargion (filmings only) multiple with comma
annotations = one or more annotation type with comma
vol = <0...1>
